name: Scatter text
what: A block of one line repeated; its letters burst apart across the frame, drift loose, and fly back into the block one after another.

learned_from.what: the burst (3-8 f), the loose letters, the S-curve return over ~29 f at 25 fps

motion: burst 6 f (expo.out), loose 22 f drifting, back 35 f (S-curve) staggered 0-8 f
